findings.evidence: Grep hits: `HopfIdealPoints.lean:56-60` defines `quotientPointsHom H I A` as `(mapPointsFunctor (mkQuotient H I)).app A`; `CommHopfAlgCat.lean:60-67` defines `mapPointsFunctor` with its `naturality` square.
findings.fix: Prove it from `quotientPointsSubgroup = (quotientPointsHom H I A).hom.range` and `((mapPointsFunctor (mkQuotient H I)).naturality χ)`, taking the image of a quotient point under `HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ`.
findings.issue: `mapPoints_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup` proves preservation by unfolding membership and evaluating every element of `I`, duplicating the naturality of the quotient-points inclusion.

findings.evidence: Grep hits: `HopfIdealPoints.lean:81-84` gives `quotientPointsHom_injective`, `HopfIdealPoints.lean:113-117` gives `quotientPointsHom_liftQuotientPoint`, and `CommHopfAlgCat.lean:60-67` supplies the existing naturality square.
findings.fix: Replace the pointwise `Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ` proof with `quotientPointsHom_injective H I B`; rewrite both sides using `quotientPointsHom_liftQuotientPoint`, and use `((mapPointsFunctor (mkQuotient H I)).naturality χ)` to commute `quotientPointsHom` with `mapPoints`.
findings.issue: `mapPoints_liftQuotientPoint` re-proves quotient factorization naturality by an elementwise quotient-generator calculation, but this is the same naturality square plus injectivity of `quotientPointsHom`.

summary: The new statements are not directly replaced by existing declarations, but two proofs rederive the quotient-points naturality square pointwise instead of using the existing natural transformation API.
